title: Azure Front Door Overview
description: Learn how Azure Front Door delivers global load balancing, SSL offload, and fast failover for multi-region applications.

data.text: Azure Front Door is a cloud load balancer and CDN service that sits at the edge of the Azure network. It routes users to the closest healthy backend using the Microsoft global network.
Front Door Standard/Premium extends the original Front Door with WAF, private link integration, and rules engine for advanced routing.

data.title: Front Door Capabilities
items: Anycast routing — users connect to the nearest Point of Presence (PoP)
SSL offload — certificates managed at the edge
URL-based routing — route /blog/* to a different backend
Failover — automatically route to a healthy region
Caching — static content cached at the edge

data.title: Create a Front Door with Two Backends
data.content: Set up Front Door Standard with primary and failover backends.
data.code:
az afd profile create   --profile-name myFrontDoor   --resource-group myRG   --sku Standard_AzureFrontDoor

az afd endpoint create   --resource-group myRG   --profile-name myFrontDoor   --endpoint-name myEndpoint   --enabled-state Enabled

az afd origin create   --resource-group myRG   --profile-name myFrontDoor   --origin-group-name myOriginGroup   --host-name myapp-eastus.azurewebsites.net   --origin-host-header myapp-eastus.azurewebsites.net

az afd route create   --resource-group myRG   --profile-name myFrontDoor   --endpoint-name myEndpoint   --route-name myRoute   --origin-group myOriginGroup   --patterns '/*'   --protocol Https

data.caption: Front Door routes users to the nearest healthy backend.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Front Door is a global entry point that routes users to the closest backend.
It provides SSL offload, WAF, caching, and failover.
Use Front Door Standard/Premium for production-grade global apps.
data.takeaway: Use Front Door when you need multi-region availability and edge-level performance.
